step_by_step_approach: Identify packaging containers that are not contained within any other packaging.
For each identified container, collect all items that appear in it or in any of its nested sub-packages.
Calculate the total quantity of each item by adding its quantities across all levels of nesting within the container.
Filter to keep only those container‑item pairs where the total quantity exceeds 500.
Return the names of the qualifying containers together with the names of the corresponding items.
